notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload adopter state. Live join/continue order wins; the seed list is a hint only. FULL PCM (851bcf7, CLI 0.7.0) + FULL CGM 0.5.12 (62340f3, eight modules) + OIO 0.1.0 (a4bba77) are pinned to release train `current`. ACS is pinned at 25be219, whose stack-mesh.json matches the train's certified PCM/CGM/OIO; the train's own ACS entry (589b0a9) still names the previous PCM/CGM and fails its own hotload_check. Boss lease is minutes (default 30, range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less and liveness-only. The decision-boss seat is vacant until the first live continuer claims it.

role_fill.notes: First live continuer with a valid lease is decision boss; later continuers fill coder or worker seats. Tool identity does not assign roles.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room; live join/continue order wins when filling vacant seats.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

acs.notes: ACS repo release 0.2.0. Pinned one commit past the train's own ACS entry (589b0a9) because 589b0a9's stack-mesh.json still requires the previous PCM 197f7ba / CGM b487b48 and so fails its own hotload_check; 25be219's mesh matches the train's certified PCM/CGM/OIO.

pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters. Continuity/checkpoints yes; still NOT the proposal/ACCEPT layer (that stays GitHub + PROPOSALS.md). Pin commit SHA; do not silently follow moving main.

cgm.notes: FULL CGM 0.5.12 required for ACS and all hotloader adopters. Eight modules including human-output-naming. Not HSW+writing-direction only. Validate with scripts/validate_content_system.py (full adapter); then apply acs_prompt_inject.

oio.notes: OIO 0.1.0 issue-log ontology, form and triage. The .oio/ managed files are byte-identical between the previously installed commit (2dace20) and this one; only the pin moves. OIO's installer needs descriptor-relative no-follow filesystem calls that Windows lacks, so it runs in CI (Linux) and refuses on Windows by design.
